1129-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Harabaz Druid has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1129-4613-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-4613-4687.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Harabaz Druid using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4862-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4862-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2281-5925-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-5263-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from steps 1 and 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

4067-7704-7890.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat.

2178-5256-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-5256-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-5256-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

676-1987-4125.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-4125.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-4125.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2034-2557-5220-6961-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2557-5220-6961-7422.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

67-2511-4053-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W}
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3317-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
997-3317-5972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1329-2178-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a nontoken artifact creature in your graveyard that can be cast using at most {C}{C}, with the mana to cast it.
1329-2178-4659.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting the artifact creature in your graveyard.
Cast the artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.
1329-2178-4659.notes: You can get infinite mana if the creature only needs {C} or less mana to cast.

1849-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

3750-7024-7025.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3750-7024-7025.description:
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering Avatar Roku, adding six {R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Upwelling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-7024-7025.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can activate Avatar Roku infinitely to give your red creatures infinite power.

283-2757-2775-6705.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Slimefoot's ability.
Resolve both Slimefoot abilities, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 4 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

2404-2645-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
2404-2645-6474.description:
Activate a creature using Gaea's Cradle's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping the creature.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

856-5631-5776-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

997-4681-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

277-880-6528.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-6528.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1494-2527-3784-4275-5686.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding an amount of {C} equal to Vhal's toughness that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Haunted One triggers, causing Humans and Wizards you control to get +2/+0 and to gain undying until end of turn.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sage of Hours.
When Sage of Hours dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Humans and Wizards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

813-2103-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Scholar of the Ages each turn.
813-2103-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Scholar of the Ages by paying its mana cost.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Scholar of the Ages from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

751-1460-1741-5914.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
751-1460-1741-5914.notes:
If you control an additional artifact, this also produces infinite mana.

If you have a creature with mana value 0 that can survive after being cast for 0 mana, you can bounce it each time in step 9 and also cast it infinite times.

230-853-2757-4875.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has a card in exile.
You control a basic Forest.
"Rat" chosen with Conspiracy.
230-853-2757-4875.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Conspiracy, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Scion, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

190-3722-3903.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell this turn.
190-3722-3903.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Colfenor's Plans and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Colfenor's Plans prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

204-776-3940.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least four creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-3940.description:
Activate four creatures you control by tapping them, adding {3}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities, Haze of Rage's storm ability, and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Haze of Rage to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve all Haze of Rages, causing creatures you control to get +1/+0 for each Haze of Rage, and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control five or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

1209-2751-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1209-2751-4067.description:
Cast Kozilek by paying {10}, triggering Kozilek.
Holding priority, activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Kozilek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Kozilek's trigger, causing you to draw four cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-3583-5308.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
1742-3583-5308.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Confessor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

126-1173-1328.notablePrerequisites:
Spellbinder attached to any creature other than Obeka.
That creature can not be blocked.
126-1173-1328.description:
Attack with equipped creature, dealing combat damage.
Copy and cast Final Fortune with the Spellbinder trigger.
Pass the turn.
Attack with equipped creature, dealing combat damage.
Copy and cast Final Fortune with the Spellbinder trigger.
Pass the turn.
When the lose the game trigger is on the stack, activate Obeka to end the turn, exiling the trigger.
Repeat steps 3-6.

2782-4050-5003.notablePrerequisites: At least two creatures have died this turn.
2782-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nevinyrral, adding {1}.
When Nevinyrral dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nevinyrral trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Nevinyrral to the battlefield from your graveyard, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Nevinyrral enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that has died this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Zombie tokens, adding {3}.
Repeat.

4694-4871.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control can die.
4694-4871.description:
Have a creature you control die.
Pitiless Plunderer makes a treasure token.
The token enters and dies as a 0/0.
Pitiless Plunderer makes a treasure token.
Repeat
